title: Unstoppable Weapons+
description: It adds a few Cool weapons with abilities (that you right click to use) and adds one new ore for one of the weapons!
body:
**It's is A Fun Mod that You can Test around and Give Feedback it adds a 5 Weapons:**
Frost Sword,
Emerald Dagger,
Tree Sword,
Inferno Hammer,
Lightning Sword.

**Each has there own thing some only have a Special Attack or some only Have a Ability (You can use the Ability but pressing Right Click) but the is a few that have a Special Attack and a Ability **

**It also Adds Two Items:**
Zapis(a New Gem Ore that can be mined with a Iron Pickaxe and is used to make the Lightning Sword)
Snowy Diamond(it's made in a crafting table it needs 2 diamonds and 2 Snow Blocks and 1 Blue ice block to make one Snowy Diamond and is used to make the Frost Sword)

**And Also Give Feedback it helps and i will keep updating the mod and maybe the will be more weapons in the furture!**
